goal: Stop penalizing remote peer addresses on one network when reachability issues are local to that network
Keep nodes from falsely marking valid peers as bad and dropping them from address relay
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate review now
agreement: Verified by testing connection logs across networks (naiyoma)
Code review ACK suggesting documentation for unreachable network trade-offs (fjahr)
Concept approval noting it matches intended connection tracking behavior (stratospher)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents valid peers on networks like Tor or IPv6 from being marked bad due to local faults
Local network outages will no longer cause nodes to stop relaying good addresses from unaffected peers
